description: imd-flop `receipt <id> --refresh` after a mock run: rows appended, the latest ledger row, the DISAGREE line on stderr, and the stored receipt file. run_read is the run's own receipt read (http 200); run_cost_flop is the usage.cost_flop its completion reported; run_complete timeout leaves no receipt file. prev_cap_charge replaces the latest row's cap_charge before the refresh. strip_receipt_fields deletes keys from the stored file before the refresh. spend_raw (money stage 1) is the latest row's exact spend, or "absent" when the row has no such field. Hold floor (KD-12, KD-13, KD-14): the cap charge is max(padded quote, settled spend, reported cost), and run_complete presend releases the hold before the refresh. reason is the latest row's reason, with the PAST_ADMITTED text written as "PAST_ADMITTED"; stderr_past_admitted says whether stderr carries it.
